description: Search USPTO patent Interference decisions — pre-AIA priority contests between competing applicants/patentees over who invented first. A SEPARATE docket from AIA trials and ex parte Appeals. Filter by `patent_number` (a patent or application involved in the contest), `party` (junior- or senior-party name, or either party's real party in interest), and/or free-text `query`. Returns the interference number, style ("A v. B"), declaration date, the junior and senior party (each with name, real party in interest, inventor, counsel, application/patent number, grant date), any additional parties, decision type/date and outcome, and the decision document link. Powered by the USPTO Open Data Portal (data.uspto.gov).

include_raw.description: Optional, default false. When true, also return raw_sample: one UNMODIFIED raw record exactly as the upstream API returned it (no field renaming), to verify or correct this tool's field mapping.

party.description: Optional. Junior- or senior-party name in the priority contest.

patent_number.description: Optional. Patent or application number involved in the interference.

query.description: Optional free-text keyword search across interference decision records.

name: ptab_search_interferences
title: Ptab Search Interferences
